name: Chim mia
summary: A small bird from the Tây Sơn cane fields. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says it is the color of a dry leaf and appears in late winter and early spring. Phú Phong is the town Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định prints.
origin: Thị trấn Phú Phong, huyện Tây Sơn. Not the Quy Nhon beach.
howToEat: The portal seasons the bird with salt, chili, scallion, pepper, a little seasoning powder, and five-spice, then grills it over charcoal or fries it in peanut oil. The grill is eaten with pepper-lime salt. The fry is finished with toasted sesame.
